Absoutely agree that its a paradox.  But also - consider this:  It was written many times by Jordan that during the War of Power, battling channelers nearly un-did reality.  I'm willing to guess that this is exactly the sort of channeling that can do it.  The pattern is able to "heal" some paradoxes, but when they happen to quickly - or too frequently - the result is catastrophe.  A circumstance where someone Balefires himself is going to send terrible shockwaves through the pattern.

In a discussion of this with a friend we believe that in situations like this, the pattern will "step back" several threads and then toss in a new circumstance which will "prevent" the paradox from happening.  Kinda like a redo.  So  - just making things up here - the balefiring channeler might suddenly "trip on a rock" that wasn't there in the inital timeline, thus preventing him from being hit by his own balefire.  The pattern can handle single paradoxical situations like this.  But when too many things happen too quickly - again like in the War of Power - the Age Lace can come undone.  And to be blunt: this is exactly what the dark one wants.
